verdict.rationale: The first-party README documents running Gitleaks as a pre-commit hook by copying the example `pre-commit.py` script into `.git/hooks/`. It also shows sample output of a commit being blocked ("Detect hardcoded secrets....Failed"), so the story's core of stopping secrets before they enter git history is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documentation of the pre-commit framework config and of scanning only staged changes, and coverage of non-secret "issues" beyond secrets.
